capabilities.notes: Model guide: docs/models/65U8HAU/V0000.06.29X.P0813/. capabilities.notes: Model guide: docs/models/65U7H/V0000.06.29X.P0813/. Started on V0000.06.21U.N1023, upgraded to V0000.06.29X.P0813 mid-research. Different bridge surface from the U9 generation: no HiUtils_createRequest, instead WebSDK_createFileRequest -> POST localhost:9009/file/<api>, origin-gated to vidaahub.com (works over plain HTTP too). Mode bases 0=/tmp, 2=channelA, 6=/APPS, 7=/OAD. The file service is fragile: reading binaries NUL-truncates, and POSTs to /hiSecurity/* kill the handler with nothing supervising it back. rc.local ships the /var/local/otaTest.sh call commented out. The U9 hiutils API table is absent on this build. Contributed by pavanjadhaw; see issue #2 for the running dialogue.

capabilities.notes: Pairing required the TV's real Wi-Fi MAC (a placeholder/random MAC is silently rejected at the MQTT layer; TLS completes but auth fails). self-install lane verified blocked: HiUtils fileWrite on websdk/Appinfo.json -> 503 'client request permission check error, please check appconfig' (fileRead ret=true returned {"AppInfo":[]}, unchanged after failed write). launcher end-to-end verified via Mac-side custom-app fallback + home-state transition broadcasts; gettvstate does NOT answer on this build (state stays null; only transition broadcasts + periodic sourcelist push), re-launching an identical custom app is deduped and needs a URL variant (?v=2). fileRead is a strict /APPS/ path joiner (no escape found). Bridge surface from a plain http page: 108 platform names on window, 85 Hisense_Get* callable; GetDeviceCode masked '000000' in page scope; getter error paths accept injected text -> read/oracle primitive only, no write privilege. Root: the browser file bridge stayed closed; the write primitive is the FaaS fetcher (basic/fetcher fetchFile, uid 314), which is a different surface from file_bridge_write. 'Architecture: mtk9603' read from the device's own opkg.conf, not from model docs; opkg status DB at /APPS/pkgs/opkgmeta/status. Persistence: a two-file service in an already-rw vendor package plus one serviceList.json entry, run by the vendor service manager at every boot as uid 314 (proven across a power-cycle). Model guide: docs/models/43Q60SEVS/V0000.09.60W.Q0612/.

capabilities.notes: Model guide: docs/models/75U8QTUK/V0000.09.60I.Q0813/. Fingerprint captured 2026-11-06 (owner-verified): firmware, Extended/Minor/RC versions, SoC, kernel arch, UA, locale, LAN nmap posture — see findings/00-fingerprint.md. Same firmware id as the EU_A 100U7Q row (V0000.09.60I.Q0813); country GBR but internal region EU_A. Launcher GET-delivery works (pages served off-LAN load in the TV browser; findings/03); the self-installing tile is untested. Root is NOT a dead end: findings/04 tested hiutils.fileRead/fileWrite with bare-string paths and never started basic/fetcher. findings/05 re-probed the chain's actual primitive: basic/fetcher fetchFile returned ret:true 'download finished' for writes to /APPS and /APPS/pkgs/tv.vidaa.jsservice.basic/CHA/, and hiutils fileRead traverses ../proc/uptime when the path is a one-element array (bare strings get 'invalid path'). findings/06 placed and invoked a self-deleting FaaS function: uid 314 / gid 314 with supplemental group 616, socket /var/run/superwatch_socket stat 0660 root:616, connect OK, command 85 -> 901:0 (code 0), process.arch 'arm', and /var/local writable by uid 314. findings/07 armed the chain: fresh static ARM32 Dropbear 2022.83 (zig musl) + minimal IPK (tools/u7q/scripts/make_min_installer.py), written via fetchFile and installed with superwatch 83+82. postinst log shows POSTINST_RAN, Uid 0, CapEff 000001ffffffffff; ssh on 8008 is key-only with a dedicated ed25519 key (server/keys/, gitignored), PTY works, /etc/shadow and /data are readable as root. State left: /APPS/.re_sshd, /APPS/shell, /APPS/installer.ipk, the sw2.js FaaS helper, package re.installer, ptmx 0666, one FIREWALL_IN_EULAON ACCEPT dpt:8008. findings/08 reboot-tested the persistence claim: after `sync; /sbin/reboot` the TV came back in ~9 s with 8008 closed, and the re-arm page (tools/u7q/web/rearm.html, served by tools/u7q/web/server.py) re-sent 83+82 through the surviving sw2.js helper, restoring uid 0 (new Dropbear pid 15290, uptime 114 s, CapEff 000001ffffffffff, PTY OK) with the same host key and no re-download. Rollback/re-arm in findings/07 and findings/08. findings/09 installed and owner-verified the native DOM Home (component-only /Launcher route swap in operation-ui, apps/inputs/TV Settings/app launch all working, tested rollback path); no reboot was performed because root SSH is not boot-persistent. findings/10 added a merged apps+inputs list and a CSS-gradient wallpaper picker in Preferences (v2 bundle; rollback then install re-verified on hardware).

Launcher lane only, 2026-11-06. Pairing: 2024 VidaaAppAndroidV01 cert (res/El.p12 from com.universal.remote.multi 1.09.05.001.0) + modern credentials; colon-formatted MAC required (12-hex form returns rc 135); PIN accepted, tokenissuance issued, and two-way actions (state/gettvstate/applist/sourcelist/launchapp) answered. Launcher page + /ws + icon proxy + server-side watcher bounce verified end-to-end; /api/open must launch appId 16 'Browser' with an overridden url - a custom appId (vidaa-recon / vidaa-home) is silently ignored on this build. Native self-install closed: HiUtils fileWrite on websdk/Appinfo.json -> {ret:false, code:503, msg:'client request permission check error, please check appconfig'}; fileRead of the same path works (4314-byte registry, 4 entries). Hisense_installApp and WebSDK_createFileRequest are absent; HiUtils_createRequest present; 95 Hisense_* functions callable; screen 1920x1080 @1.5. transport_protocol not measured (SSDP multicast filtered on the test LAN). Root not attempted.
Root via browser path traversal + otaTest.sh boot hook; native Node v20 runtime; native UI debloat mapped via hiddenApps.json
